DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION NO. 145 s. 2022 Ntv 14 HON. VICTOR M. BUENDIA Punong Barangay Barangay Labangon Cebu City Dear PB Buendia: This has reference to your letter dated 13 September 2022 requesting for this Department's legal opinion on whether you may be allowed to join the bidding and enter into contract with the DPWH Region VII, as an owner of a construction business. At the outset, it may be prudent to highlight the rule on conflict of interest which is enshrined under RA 6713 or the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards. Conflict of interest arises when a public official or employee is a member of a board, an officer, or a substantial stockholder of a private corporation or owner or has a substantial interest in a business, and the interest of such corporation or business, or his rights or duties therein, may be opposed to or affected by the faithful performance of official duty. 1 When there is a conflict of interest, Section 9 of RA 6713 or the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards is instructive as to its implications: "Section 9. Divestment. - A public official or employee shall avoid conflict of interest at all times. When a conflict of interest arises. he shall resiqn from his position in anv private business enterprise within thirty (30) days from his assumption of office and/or divest himself of his shareholdin s or interest within sixt (60) days from such assumption. The same rule shall apply where the public official or employee is a partner in a partnership. Xxx" (Emphasis ours) The Local Government Code of 1991 is also not wanting in addressing the issue of conflict of interest. Section 89(a)(1) thereof provides: "SECTION 89. Prohibited Business and Pecuniary Interest. — (a) It shall be unlawful for any local government official or employee, directly or indirectly, to: (1) Engage in any business transaction with the local government unit in which he is an official or employee or over which he has the power of supervision, or with any of its authorized boards, officials, agents, or attomeys, whereby money is to 1 Section 3(i), RA No. 6713 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

be paid, or property or any other thing of value is to be transferred, directly or indirectly, out of the resources of the local government unit to such person or firm" The clear import of this Section is the prohibition to engage in any business transaction with the local government unit in which he is an official. Needless to state, we are of the view that you may participate in the bidding and may enter a contract with the DPWH, provided that, the business transaction/s should not involve the Barangay where you are an incumbent elected official nor conducted within your barangay's territorial jurisdiction. In sum, there are two requisites herein: (1) no conflict of interest; and (2) the transaction should be outside your territorial jurisdiction. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BYA OR OF THE SEC TARY: VI TOR R. LLAMAS Und secr tary for External, Legal and Legislative Affai OUSE VRULLLS-LPALLD/rrao/clp copy furnish: DIR. LEOCADIO T.
